title: When to Visit Sri Lanka
excerpt: A thoughtful guide to the island's contrasting seasons and what they mean for your journey.
content: Sri Lanka has more than one travel season. The south and west typically follow a different rainfall pattern from the east, making it possible to plan rewarding journeys in different months. Weather changes, so plan with flexibility and check the forecast close to departure.

title: The Train Through Tea Country
excerpt: A journey through green hills, tea plantations and a landscape that stays with you.
content: Sri Lanka’s hill-country railway winds between valleys, tea estates and mountain villages. Travel times and seat availability vary. Plan well in advance, leave room for delays and consider a short scenic section rather than rushing through the whole journey.

title: A Guide to Sri Lankan Food
excerpt: Discover coconut-rich curries, market flavours and the pleasure of eating together.
content: From hoppers and sambols to fragrant rice and curry, food is a wonderful introduction to the island. Try local produce, ask about spice levels and choose places that prepare food with care.

title: Beyond the Postcard: Galle
excerpt: A layered coastal city where old streets open onto the Indian Ocean.
content: Galle Fort invites slower exploration. Walk the ramparts, step into shaded courtyards and discover the small businesses that give this neighbourhood its rhythm.

title: Meeting Sri Lanka's Wildlife Responsibly
excerpt: The most memorable wildlife encounters begin with respect for the habitat.
content: A safari is never a promise of sightings. Give animals space, follow park rules and choose operators who prioritise safe, patient observation.

title: The Ancient Cultural Triangle
excerpt: An introduction to historic cities, sacred places and a rich cultural landscape.
content: Sigiriya, Dambulla, Polonnaruwa and Anuradhapura each tell a different story. Allow enough time to learn and observe local customs, particularly when entering active places of worship.
